prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in steps has been helpful overall (+4.0% average after noise correction), winning 2 tests while 2 showed no clear effect.
Home redesign changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests (-3.2% average after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_flow, adoption new_screen, adoption redesign, choose_path redesign, finish new_screen, and sign_in redesign, as only 1 test has been completed for each.
Predictions were generally too high for failed or neutral tests, but underestimated performance on major winning tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +3.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, new_screen: +7.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -7.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +5.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -7.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: -3.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: -0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +4.0% after noise correction, 4 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 80.6%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 80.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 70.8%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 24.2%

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in after pet generation waiting step: Move the sign-in step to occur immediately after the waiting screen, allowing users to experience full pet generation before creating an account. (why: Signing in before pet creation causes friction early in the funnel; moving authentication after pet generation leverages user investment.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop pet interaction quickstart screen: Add a new interactive quickstart screen right before completing onboarding that demonstrates basic pet interaction and desktop visibility controls. (why: Multiple support tickets report confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding completes.)
2: [adoption, redesign] Spotlight layout redesign for custom photo upload screen: Redesign the upload_photos screen using a spotlight layout with focused photo drop zones and clear photo guidelines. (why: Adoption step has a 70.8% conversion rate with long mean duration (1017s) and support emails report custom pet upload failures.)
3: [home, redesign] Two column redesign for desktop pet generation waiting screen: Redesign the waiting screen into a two-column layout showing generation progress alongside pet background details. (why: The waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to drop-off while waiting for pet creation.)
4: [choose_path, new_screen] Pet companion quiz screen before path selection: Add a brief pet companion quiz screen before path selection to help users decide between preset pets and custom photo uploads. (why: Choose path takes a high mean time (514s), indicating user hesitation when picking an adoption route.)
5: [home, wait_info] Background completion notification toggle on waiting screen: Add a desktop notification prompt and live time estimate to the waiting screen so users can navigate away safely while generation completes. (why: The waiting step mean duration is 2336 seconds, causing users to abandon the app while waiting for background processing.)
6: [finish, incentive] Desktop widget preview component on home intro screen: Add a desktop widget preview card and readiness badge to the home intro screen to confirm pet readiness before finishing. (why: Finish step conversion is 64.8% and support received tickets about pets not appearing on the desktop post-onboarding.)
7: [adoption, hint] Custom photo quality hint banner on photo upload screen: Add an explicit photo upload guidance hint banner on the photo upload screen explaining lighting and pose requirements. (why: Support received multiple reports of custom pet generation failing or rendering unexpected visual outputs.)
8: [choose_path, copy] Story screen benefit copy focus update: Update headline and body on the story screen to clearly highlight instant desktop availability and companion features. (why: Improving initial value proposition messaging reduces drop-off at the start of the onboarding flow.)
9: [sign_in, notification] Sign-in cloud backup notification badge: Add a cloud sync badge and explanatory hint to the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing in preserves their pet data. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or resetting after signing in again on subsequent app launches.)

scores.note: Reordering sign-in has strong empirical backing (+4.0% avg across 4 tests).
Adding a new screen at finish step previously resulted in a -7.0% drop.
Adoption redesigns previously showed negative results (-7.8%).
Home redesigns consistently underperformed (-3.2% avg across 2 tests).
Adding new quiz screens increases drop-off friction.
Directly targets high wait duration without full layout redesign.
Addresses support tickets about missing pets on high drop-off finish step.
Low-cost guidance hint solves custom photo failures highlighted in support emails.
Low-risk copy updates clarify early value proposition.
Strong support evidence (8 tickets) solved via simple copy badge.
